records.translation:
spaCR이 보관하는 항목(병합 프레임, 불러온 이미지, 모델 가중치)이 해제되기 전까지 사용되지 않은 채 머무를 수 있는 시간입니다. 0이면 더 이상 필요하지 않은 즉시 해제하므로, 다시 사용할 때 시간이 걸립니다.

이 설정은 라이브러리를 언로드하지 않습니다. Python C 확장은 언로드할 수 없으며, 여기서도 그렇지 않은 척하지 않습니다. 이 설정이 관리하는 것은 spaCR이 보관하기로 한 항목입니다.

권장:
{levels}

records.key: How many cells a well's montage puts on a row. The count stays the same whatever size the window is — a wider panel draws the same cells larger, up to their natural size, rather than fitting more of them in, so two wells are always laid out alike. How many ROWS fit is still measured, because that is what decides the page.
records.source: How many cells a well's montage puts on a row. The count stays the same whatever size the window is — a wider panel draws the same cells larger, up to their natural size, rather than fitting more of them in, so two wells are always laid out alike. How many ROWS fit is still measured, because that is what decides the page.
records.translation: 웰 몽타주 한 행에 놓는 세포 수입니다. 창 크기와 상관없이 이 수는 같습니다. 패널이 넓어지면 더 많은 세포를 넣는 대신 같은 세포를 원래 크기까지 더 크게 그리므로, 두 웰은 항상 같은 방식으로 배치됩니다. 몇 개의 행이 들어가는지는 여전히 측정하는데, 그것이 페이지를 결정하기 때문입니다.

records.key: How many cores the fit is spread over, and how much it prints on the way. Lower the worker count when the machine has other work to do; raise the verbosity when a fit is failing and you cannot see where.
records.source: How many cores the fit is spread over, and how much it prints on the way. Lower the worker count when the machine has other work to do; raise the verbosity when a fit is failing and you cannot see where.
records.translation: 적합에 사용할 코어 수와 진행 중 출력량입니다. 컴퓨터에서 다른 작업을 해야 할 때는 워커 수를 줄이고, 적합이 실패하는데 어디서 실패하는지 보이지 않으면 출력 상세도를 높이세요.

records.key: How many files were read, how many distinct wells, fields and channels they hold, what could not be placed, and what was named unlike the rest and therefore not interpreted.
records.source: How many files were read, how many distinct wells, fields and channels they hold, what could not be placed, and what was named unlike the rest and therefore not interpreted.
records.translation: 읽은 파일 수, 그 파일들에 담긴 서로 다른 웰, 시야, 채널의 수, 배치할 수 없었던 항목, 그리고 나머지와 다르게 이름이 붙어 해석하지 않은 항목입니다.

records.key: How many reads each well is allotted. Too few and guide counts become noise before any biology is involved, which no amount of extra replicates recovers.
records.source: How many reads each well is allotted. Too few and guide counts become noise before any biology is involved, which no amount of extra replicates recovers.
records.translation: 각 웰에 할당되는 리드 수입니다. 너무 적으면 생물학적 효과가 관여하기도 전에 가이드 수가 잡음이 되며, 반복을 아무리 늘려도 회복되지 않습니다.

records.key: How many worker processes the assay uses. Lower it when the machine has other work to do.
records.source: How many worker processes the assay uses. Lower it when the machine has other work to do.
records.translation: 분석에 사용할 워커 프로세스 수입니다. 컴퓨터에서 다른 작업을 해야 할 때는 줄이세요.

records.key: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up when a well comes out empty and you need to see which step discarded its parasites.
records.source: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up when a well comes out empty and you need to see which step discarded its parasites.
records.translation: 분석 실행 중 출력하는 정보의 양입니다. 웰이 비어 나왔고 어느 단계에서 기생충이 버려졌는지 확인해야 할 때 높이세요.

records.key: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up while you are still deciding on a threshold and need to see which wells the controls were drawn from.
records.source: How much the assay prints as it runs. Turn it up while you are still deciding on a threshold and need to see which wells the controls were drawn from.
records.translation: 분석 실행 중 출력하는 정보의 양입니다. 아직 임계값을 정하는 중이고 대조군을 어느 웰에서 가져왔는지 확인해야 할 때 높이세요.

records.key: How parasites are assigned to vacuoles and counted into replication states, including the warning raised when a vacuole holds a biologically implausible, non-power-of-two number of parasites.
records.source: How parasites are assigned to vacuoles and counted into replication states, including the warning raised when a vacuole holds a biologically implausible, non-power-of-two number of parasites.
records.translation: 기생충을 액포에 할당하고 복제 상태로 세는 방식이며, 액포에 생물학적으로 타당하지 않은(2의 거듭제곱이 아닌) 수의 기생충이 있을 때 표시되는 경고도 포함합니다.

records.key: How points, outlines and image thumbnails are rendered. These presentation controls never refit or move the embedding.
records.source: How points, outlines and image thumbnails are rendered. These presentation controls never refit or move the embedding.
records.translation: 포인트, 출처 및 이미지 템플릿이 어떻게 생성되는지.이 프레젠테이션 컨트롤은 결코 임베딩을 재현하거나 이동하지 않습니다.

records.key: How the estimate itself is produced — the level the score is computed at, the backend that runs it, and the random seed. Fix the seed when you want two designs compared rather than two draws.
records.source: How the estimate itself is produced — the level the score is computed at, the backend that runs it, and the random seed. Fix the seed when you want two designs compared rather than two draws.
records.translation: 추정값 자체를 만드는 방식입니다. 점수를 계산하는 수준, 이를 실행하는 백엔드, 랜덤 시드를 다룹니다. 두 번의 추출이 아니라 두 설계를 비교하려면 시드를 고정하세요.

records.key: How the feature table is reduced to two dimensions and clustered on top of that — neighbourhood size, distance metric, and the DBSCAN/KMeans parameters with their noise handling. Change these when the embedding is one undifferentiated blob, or shatters into dozens of tiny clusters.
records.source: How the feature table is reduced to two dimensions and clustered on top of that — neighbourhood size, distance metric, and the DBSCAN/KMeans parameters with their noise handling. Change these when the embedding is one undifferentiated blob, or shatters into dozens of tiny clusters.
records.translation: 특징 테이블을 2차원으로 축소하고 그 위에서 클러스터링하는 방식입니다. 이웃 크기, 거리 척도, 잡음 처리를 포함한 DBSCAN/KMeans 매개변수를 다룹니다. 임베딩이 구분되지 않는 하나의 덩어리이거나 수십 개의 작은 클러스터로 쪼개질 때 바꾸세요.

records.key: How the library is spread over physical plates — wells per plate, plate count, replicates and cells sampled per well. These values determine the physical plate and acquisition requirements.
records.source: How the library is spread over physical plates — wells per plate, plate count, replicates and cells sampled per well. These values determine the physical plate and acquisition requirements.
records.translation: 라이브러리를 물리적 플레이트에 배분하는 방식입니다. 플레이트당 웰 수, 플레이트 수, 반복, 웰당 샘플링하는 세포 수를 다룹니다. 이 값이 필요한 물리적 플레이트와 영상 획득 요건을 결정합니다.

records.key: How the model is fitted — epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.source: How the model is fitted — epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.translation: 모델을 적합하는 방식입니다. 에포크, 학습률, 스케줄, 손실 함수를 다룹니다. 학습이 불안정하거나, 멈추거나, 작은 클래스를 무시할 때 여세요.

records.key: How the model is fitted: epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.source: How the model is fitted: epochs, learning rate, schedule, and which loss. Open it when training is unstable, stalls, or ignores the smaller class.
records.translation: 모델을 적합하는 방식: 에포크, 학습률, 스케줄, 손실 함수. 학습이 불안정하거나, 멈추거나, 작은 클래스를 무시할 때 여세요.

records.key: How the pathogen mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Tightly packed parasites fusing into one object are the usual reason to come here.
records.source: How the pathogen mask is found — model, expected diameter, probability and flow thresholds; the channel preprocessing and the size filters are under Advanced settings. Tightly packed parasites fusing into one object are the usual reason to come here.
records.translation: 어떻게 병원체 마스크가 발견되는지 - 모델, 예상 직경, 확률 및 흐름 경계; 채널 사전 처리 및 크기 필터는 고급 설정 아래에 있습니다.

records.key: How wells that received too few reads are detected and whether they are dropped before the rest of the analysis. Leaving them in drags every plate-level summary toward noise, so exclude them once you trust the read floor above.
records.source: How wells that received too few reads are detected and whether they are dropped before the rest of the analysis. Leaving them in drags every plate-level summary toward noise, so exclude them once you trust the read floor above.
records.translation: 리드를 너무 적게 받은 웰을 검출하는 방식과, 나머지 분석 전에 그 웰을 제외할지 여부입니다. 남겨 두면 모든 플레이트 수준 요약이 잡음 쪽으로 끌려가므로, 위의 리드 하한을 신뢰하게 되면 제외하세요.

records.key: Join the crop table: its path and its classification score. Every morphological measurement is in the object tables beside it, and the score is not in any of them.
records.source: Join the crop table: its path and its classification score. Every morphological measurement is in the object tables beside it, and the score is not in any of them.
records.translation: 크롭 테이블에 합류하십시오 : 그것의 경로와 그것의 분류 점수.모든 형태의 측정은 그것 옆에있는 개체 표에 있으며, 점수는 그들 중 어느 것도 없습니다.

records.key: Leave out a guide present in more than this share of the wells. Highly prevalent guides can have much greater precision than rare guides and may be associated with many measurements. Use the 'hits vs representation' view to choose a threshold from this screen rather than assuming prevalence is harmless.
records.source: Leave out a guide present in more than this share of the wells. Highly prevalent guides can have much greater precision than rare guides and may be associated with many measurements. Use the 'hits vs representation' view to choose a threshold from this screen rather than assuming prevalence is harmless.
records.translation: 이 비율보다 많은 웰에 존재하는 가이드를 제외합니다. 매우 흔한 가이드는 드문 가이드보다 정밀도가 훨씬 높을 수 있고 많은 측정값과 연관될 수 있습니다. 흔한 것이 무해하다고 가정하지 말고 'hits vs representation' 보기를 사용해 이 스크리닝에 맞는 임계값을 고르세요.

records.key: Links a selected regression run, gene, phenotype direction, false-discovery rate, and guide support to measured cells. The initial output ranks candidates by their scores. An optional hierarchical mixture model estimates cross-fitted hit-like probabilities without equating sequencing fraction with cell prevalence. Comparisons treat wells as independent units, and stored calls are versioned without replacing manual annotations.
records.source: Links a selected regression run, gene, phenotype direction, false-discovery rate, and guide support to measured cells. The initial output ranks candidates by their scores. An optional hierarchical mixture model estimates cross-fitted hit-like probabilities without equating sequencing fraction with cell prevalence. Comparisons treat wells as independent units, and stored calls are versioned without replacing manual annotations.
records.translation: 선택한 회귀 실행, 유전자, 표현형 방향, 위발견율, 가이드 지지를 측정된 세포와 연결합니다. 초기 출력은 점수에 따라 후보의 순위를 매깁니다. 선택적인 계층적 혼합 모형은 시퀀싱 비율을 세포 유병률과 동일시하지 않고 교차 적합된 히트 유사 확률을 추정합니다. 비교에서는 웰을 독립 단위로 다루며, 저장된 판정은 수동 어노테이션을 대체하지 않고 버전으로 관리됩니다.

records.key: Load a table and press Scan. Everything printed here — the counts, the thresholds and the caveats — comes from spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model, which is also the headless entry point.
records.source: Load a table and press Scan. Everything printed here — the counts, the thresholds and the caveats — comes from spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model, which is also the headless entry point.
records.translation: 테이블을 불러오고 Scan을 누르세요. 여기에 출력되는 모든 것(개수, 임계값, 주의 사항)은 spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model 모듈에서 나오며, 이 모듈은 화면 없이 쓰는 진입점이기도 합니다.

records.key: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.source: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.translation: 테이블을 불러오거나 Merge tables로 검증된 키와 집계를 갖춘 작업 세트를 만드세요. 실제 특징/좌표 열에 임계값 또는 다각형 게이트를 정의한 다음, 저장된 게이트를 호환되는 객체에 적용하세요. Annotate로 표시된 게이트를 어노테이션 열에 기록하고, 선택된 객체를 검토한 뒤 이진 또는 다중 클래스 레이블을 고르세요.

records.key: Load crops first.
records.source: Load crops first.
records.translation: 우선 크롭을 뿌리십시오.

records.key: Look up what any measured feature means — its definition, its unit, which objects it exists for and which module computes it.
records.source: Look up what any measured feature means — its definition, its unit, which objects it exists for and which module computes it.
records.translation: 측정된 특징의 의미를 찾아봅니다. 정의, 단위, 어떤 객체에 존재하는지, 어떤 모듈이 계산하는지를 보여 줍니다.

records.key: MAD and IQR test one feature at a time. Mahalanobis tests the features together and is the only one that can see a combination going wrong while each column on its own looks ordinary.
records.source: MAD and IQR test one feature at a time. Mahalanobis tests the features together and is the only one that can see a combination going wrong while each column on its own looks ordinary.
records.translation: MAD와 IQR은 특징을 하나씩 검정합니다. Mahalanobis는 특징을 함께 검정하며, 각 열은 따로 보면 평범해 보여도 조합이 어긋나는 경우를 볼 수 있는 유일한 방법입니다.

records.key: MEASURED 2026-08-18: {small_genes} genes/{small_wells} wells took {small_ols:g}s as ols and {small_mixed:g}s as mixed ({small_ratio:g}x); {big_genes}/{big_wells}, {big_ols:g}s against {big_mixed:g}s ({big_ratio:g}x) -- and both were gene level only. This fit adds a random effect per guide too, so {guides} guides over {wells} wells is tens of minutes to hours. Single-threaded REML: one core at 100% is a healthy fit, not a hang. For an answer now, use ols at level='both'.
records.source: MEASURED 2026-08-18: {small_genes} genes/{small_wells} wells took {small_ols:g}s as ols and {small_mixed:g}s as mixed ({small_ratio:g}x); {big_genes}/{big_wells}, {big_ols:g}s against {big_mixed:g}s ({big_ratio:g}x) -- and both were gene level only. This fit adds a random effect per guide too, so {guides} guides over {wells} wells is tens of minutes to hours. Single-threaded REML: one core at 100% is a healthy fit, not a hang. For an answer now, use ols at level='both'.
records.translation: 측정 2026-08-18: 유전자 {small_genes}개/웰 {small_wells}개에서 ols는 {small_ols:g}초, mixed는 {small_mixed:g}초({small_ratio:g}배)가 걸렸습니다. {big_genes}/{big_wells}에서는 {big_ols:g}초 대 {big_mixed:g}초({big_ratio:g}배)였으며, 둘 다 유전자 수준만이었습니다. 이 적합은 가이드마다 랜덤 효과도 추가하므로, 가이드 {guides}개를 웰 {wells}개에 걸쳐 적합하면 수십 분에서 몇 시간이 걸립니다. 단일 스레드 REML이므로 코어 하나가 100%인 것은 정상적인 적합이지 멈춘 것이 아닙니다. 지금 바로 답이 필요하면 level='both'에서 ols를 사용하세요.

records.key: Map sequencing reads to gRNA barcodes and link them to screen wells.
records.source: Map sequencing reads to gRNA barcodes and link them to screen wells.
records.translation: 시퀀싱 리드를 gRNA 바코드에 매핑하고 스크리닝 웰에 연결합니다.

records.key: Maximum number of objects in one montage. For merged image sources, input/output cost depends primarily on the number of source fields accessed rather than the number of crops. A montage spanning many wells can therefore be expensive even when it contains few crops from each well.
records.source: Maximum number of objects in one montage. For merged image sources, input/output cost depends primarily on the number of source fields accessed rather than the number of crops. A montage spanning many wells can therefore be expensive even when it contains few crops from each well.
records.translation: 몽타주 하나에 들어가는 최대 객체 수입니다. 병합 이미지 원본의 경우 입출력 비용은 주로 크롭 수가 아니라 접근하는 원본 시야 수에 따라 달라집니다. 따라서 많은 웰에 걸친 몽타주는 웰마다 크롭이 적더라도 비용이 클 수 있습니다.

records.key: Measure the objects OUTSIDE the ROI instead — 'exclude this debris' rather than 'measure this colony'.
records.source: Measure the objects OUTSIDE the ROI instead — 'exclude this debris' rather than 'measure this colony'.
records.translation: 대신 ROI 바깥의 객체를 측정합니다. '이 콜로니를 측정'이 아니라 '이 잔해를 제외'하는 것입니다.

records.key: Name the independent observational unit used by the test. Use wells rather than individual cells when wells are the replicates; treating correlated cells as independent can greatly overstate significance.
records.source: Name the independent observational unit used by the test. Use wells rather than individual cells when wells are the replicates; treating correlated cells as independent can greatly overstate significance.
records.translation: 검정에서 사용하는 독립 관측 단위를 지정합니다. 웰이 반복 단위이면 개별 세포 대신 웰을 사용하세요. 상관된 세포를 독립으로 다루면 유의성이 크게 과장될 수 있습니다.

records.key: No (plate, well, field) group has two or more time points — a motility preview needs a time series.
records.source: No (plate, well, field) group has two or more time points — a motility preview needs a time series.
records.translation: 시점이 두 개 이상인 (plate, well, field) 그룹이 없습니다. 운동성 미리 보기에는 시계열이 필요합니다.

records.key: No cached masks for these segmentation settings — hit Run preview.
records.source: No cached masks for these segmentation settings — hit Run preview.
records.translation: 이러한 분할 설정에 대한 캐시 마스크가 없습니다 — 히트 실행 사전 보기.

records.key: No microscope lights a field evenly, so the same cell measures brighter at the centre than at a corner — routinely 10–40% on a widefield screen, and it does not average out of a per-well aggregate. This estimates the illumination field from the plate's own merged fields (a per-pixel median across fields, then a smooth low-order surface), QCs it, and installs it as a preprocessing hook that every measure worker applies before a single feature is computed.
records.source: No microscope lights a field evenly, so the same cell measures brighter at the centre than at a corner — routinely 10–40% on a widefield screen, and it does not average out of a per-well aggregate. This estimates the illumination field from the plate's own merged fields (a per-pixel median across fields, then a smooth low-order surface), QCs it, and installs it as a preprocessing hook that every measure worker applies before a single feature is computed.
records.translation: 어떤 현미경도 시야를 고르게 비추지 않으므로, 같은 세포라도 모서리보다 중앙에서 더 밝게 측정됩니다. 광시야 스크리닝에서는 흔히 10–40%에 이르며, 웰 단위 집계로도 상쇄되지 않습니다. 이 기능은 플레이트 자체의 병합 시야에서 조명 필드를 추정하고(시야 간 픽셀별 중앙값 후 매끄러운 저차 곡면), QCs 품질 검사를 한 뒤, 모든 측정 워커가 특징을 하나라도 계산하기 전에 적용하는 전처리 훅으로 설치합니다.

records.key: Normalize each field
records.source: Normalize each field
records.translation: 각 시야 정규화

records.key: Object-shaped crops follow the object's mask boundary and preserve its morphology. A source containing coordinates but no masks supports bounding-box crops only; object-shaped mode is disabled with an explanation for such sources.
records.source: Object-shaped crops follow the object's mask boundary and preserve its morphology. A source containing coordinates but no masks supports bounding-box crops only; object-shaped mode is disabled with an explanation for such sources.
records.translation: 개체 형식의 크롭은 개체의 마스크 경계를 따르고 그것의 형태를 보존합니다. 코디네이트를 포함하는 출처 그러나 마스크가없는 것은 단지 묶기 상자 크롭을 지원합니다. 개체 모드는 그러한 출처에 대한 설명을 사용하지 않습니다.

records.key: Objects included in the plot. 'gRNAs' displays only objects annotated with the guides selected on the volcano. 'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells' also displays the remaining objects from those wells with a distinct encoding. Comparing objects within the same wells controls for their shared plate, acquisition, staining, and imaging conditions.
records.source: Objects included in the plot. 'gRNAs' displays only objects annotated with the guides selected on the volcano. 'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells' also displays the remaining objects from those wells with a distinct encoding. Comparing objects within the same wells controls for their shared plate, acquisition, staining, and imaging conditions.
records.translation: 플롯에 포함할 객체입니다. 'gRNAs'는 볼케이노에서 선택한 가이드로 어노테이션된 객체만 표시합니다. 'gRNAs + other datapoints in selected wells'는 그 웰의 나머지 객체도 다른 표시 방식으로 보여 줍니다. 같은 웰 안의 객체를 비교하면 공유하는 플레이트, 영상 획득, 염색, 이미징 조건이 통제됩니다.

records.key: On, the crop is the rectangle around the object and keeps whatever else falls inside it. Off, everything outside the mask is removed -- which only the array source can do.
records.source: On, the crop is the rectangle around the object and keeps whatever else falls inside it. Off, everything outside the mask is removed -- which only the array source can do.
records.translation: 위에, 크롭은 개체 주위의 직경이며, 다른 모든 것이 그 안에 떨어지는 것을 유지합니다. 밖으로, 마스크 밖의 모든 것이 제거됩니다 - 그것은 단지 뿌리 출처가 할 수 있습니다.

records.key: On: objects are brighter than background, as in fluorescence. Off: take the dark side instead, for brightfield or stain.
records.source: On: objects are brighter than background, as in fluorescence. Off: take the dark side instead, for brightfield or stain.
records.translation: 켜짐: 형광에서처럼 객체가 배경보다 밝습니다. 꺼짐: 명시야나 염색 이미지에서는 대신 어두운 쪽을 사용합니다.

records.key: Only retrieve crops without a human class label in the current annotation column. Cleared labels (blank or 0) and unanswered model suggestions remain eligible. The selected reference crop stays visible even when labelled.
records.source: Only retrieve crops without a human class label in the current annotation column. Cleared labels (blank or 0) and unanswered model suggestions remain eligible. The selected reference crop stays visible even when labelled.
records.translation: 현재 어노테이션 열에 인간 클래스 라벨이없는 크롭만 얻을 수 있습니다. 깨끗한 라벨 (흰색 또는 0) 및 응답되지 않은 모델 제안은 여전히 유효합니다. 선택한 참조 크롭은 라벨을 표시 할 때조차도 눈에 띄게 유지됩니다.

records.key: Open these crops in Annotate, most confident first. If the model is this certain and disagrees, look at the annotation.
records.source: Open these crops in Annotate, most confident first. If the model is this certain and disagrees, look at the annotation.
records.translation: Annotate에서 이러한 크롭을 열고, 가장 먼저 자신감을 갖습니다.이 모델이 확실하고 동의하지 않는다면, 어노테이션을 살펴보십시오.

records.key: Optional work done after the matrix is written: computing an embedding inside the exported object, and recording it as a run artifact so later steps can find it. Both are off by default because both cost time.
records.source: Optional work done after the matrix is written: computing an embedding inside the exported object, and recording it as a run artifact so later steps can find it. Both are off by default because both cost time.
records.translation: 매트릭스가 작성 된 후에 수행 된 선택 작업 : 수출 된 개체 내부에 임베딩을 컴퓨팅하고 실행 아티팩으로 기록하여 나중에 단계가 그것을 찾을 수 있습니다.

records.key: Optional: point at a folder or stack of ready-made label images to skip segmentation entirely.
records.source: Optional: point at a folder or stack of ready-made label images to skip segmentation entirely.
records.translation: 선택: 포스터 또는 준비된 레이블 이미지의 스택을 포인트하여 분할을 완전히 벗어납니다.

records.key: Order stored in the PNG file. RGB keeps standard PNG channels unchanged. Auto uses spaCR's sidecar/database format marker. Legacy BGR repairs crops written by older cv2-based releases. After decoding, Annotate always uses RGB arrays.
records.source: Order stored in the PNG file. RGB keeps standard PNG channels unchanged. Auto uses spaCR's sidecar/database format marker. Legacy BGR repairs crops written by older cv2-based releases. After decoding, Annotate always uses RGB arrays.
records.translation: 명령은 그 안에 보관되어 있다. PNG 파일이 있습니다. RGB 표준을 유지 PNG 채널은 변하지 않습니다.자동차 사용 spaCR's 측면 / 데이터베이스 형식 마커. Legacy BGR는 오래된 크롭에 의해 작성 된 크롭을 수리합니다. cv2-베이스 릴리스. decoding 후, Annotate 항상 사용 RGB 아레아스

records.key: Outline each segmented object, coloured by the track it belongs to.
records.source: Outline each segmented object, coloured by the track it belongs to.
records.translation: 각 분할된 개체를 그가 속한 트랙에 따라 색칠합니다.

records.key: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.source: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.translation: 채널별(염색당 한 번 처리)

records.key: Percentile-normalize the field before segmenting it, which is what Cellpose expects. Turn it off only for data already normalized upstream, where doing it twice changes the result.
records.source: Percentile-normalize the field before segmenting it, which is what Cellpose expects. Turn it off only for data already normalized upstream, where doing it twice changes the result.
records.translation: 그것을 분할하기 전에 필드를 비율적으로 정상화, 그것은 무엇입니까? Cellpose 그것을 끄는 것은 이미 정상화 된 데이터를 위해서만, 그것을 두 번하는 것은 결과를 변경합니다.

records.key: Pick the wells off a plate map. Rows (r1), columns (c1) and wells (A01) all read, and what it writes reads back.
records.source: Pick the wells off a plate map. Rows (r1), columns (c1) and wells (A01) all read, and what it writes reads back.
records.translation: 플레이트 맵에서 웰을 고르세요. 행(r1), 열(c1), 웰(A01) 형식을 모두 읽으며, 기록한 값은 다시 읽을 수 있습니다.

records.key: Pixels nearest the click that are not judged. One pixel widening to two is a ratio of 2 and means nothing, so the first rows out of the seed are skipped.
records.source: Pixels nearest the click that are not judged. One pixel widening to two is a ratio of 2 and means nothing, so the first rows out of the seed are skipped.
records.translation: 클릭 지점에 가장 가까워 판정하지 않는 픽셀입니다. 한 픽셀이 두 픽셀로 넓어지는 것은 비율로 2이지만 아무 의미가 없으므로, 시드에서 시작하는 첫 행들은 건너뜁니다.

records.key: Planning — reading tile headers and overlap strips…
records.source: Planning — reading tile headers and overlap strips…
records.translation: 계획 - 타일 헤드셋을 읽고 스트립을 덮는 ...

records.key: Point spaCR at your images however they are named and arranged — Yokogawa, CQ1, Opera Phenix, ImageXpress, OME-TIFFs, a folder per well or a folder per dye. The naming is worked out from what varies across the folder rather than chosen from a list, and the parse is shown below, one row per file, before anything is written.
records.source: Point spaCR at your images however they are named and arranged — Yokogawa, CQ1, Opera Phenix, ImageXpress, OME-TIFFs, a folder per well or a folder per dye. The naming is worked out from what varies across the folder rather than chosen from a list, and the parse is shown below, one row per file, before anything is written.
records.translation: 이미지의 이름이나 배치 방식과 상관없이 spaCR이 이미지를 가리키게 하세요. Yokogawa, CQ1, Opera Phenix, ImageXpress, OME-TIFFs, 웰별 폴더 또는 염료별 폴더를 지원합니다. 이름 규칙은 목록에서 고르는 대신 폴더 안에서 달라지는 부분으로부터 알아내며, 무엇이든 기록하기 전에 파일당 한 행으로 해석 결과를 아래에 보여 줍니다.

records.key: Poisson GLM with a log link and offset(log(cell_count)) for per-well counts. The offset makes coefficients represent effects on the per-cell rate rather than total cell count, preventing differences in cell count from being interpreted as phenotype effects.
records.source: Poisson GLM with a log link and offset(log(cell_count)) for per-well counts. The offset makes coefficients represent effects on the per-cell rate rather than total cell count, preventing differences in cell count from being interpreted as phenotype effects.
records.translation: 웰별 개수에 대해 log 링크와 offset(log(cell_count))을 쓰는 Poisson GLM입니다. offset으로 인해 계수는 전체 세포 수가 아니라 세포당 비율에 대한 효과를 나타내므로, 세포 수 차이가 표현형 효과로 해석되지 않습니다.

records.key: Put the well hierarchy on the rows — what a plate summary is
records.source: Put the well hierarchy on the rows — what a plate summary is
records.translation: 웰 계층을 행에 배치합니다 — 플레이트 요약의 형태입니다

records.key: Ranking {count} fields by segmentation uncertainty: {passes} detection runs each…
records.source: Ranking {count} fields by segmentation uncertainty: {passes} detection runs each…
records.translation: 분할 불확실성에 따라 {count} 필드를 순위 : {passes} 탐지는 각각 실행됩니다.

records.key: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: how many, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable.
records.source: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: how many, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable.
records.translation: 추론 방식이 비모수 검정으로 정해질 때만 읽습니다. 순열 자체를 제어합니다. 순열 횟수, 고정할 단위(보통 플레이트), 랜덤 시드, 그리고 가이드가 검정 가능해지기 전에 나타나야 하는 웰 수입니다.

records.key: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: what is measured, how many reshuffles, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable. They apply to the gene pass as well as the guide pass: a gene is tested as a SET, its regressor the sum of its guides' fractions, permuted with the same scheme and the same seed and corrected as its own family — never by combining its guides' P values, which would assume an independence guides scored in the same wells do not have.
records.source: Read only when inference resolves to the nonparametric test. These control the permutation itself: what is measured, how many reshuffles, what is held fixed (normally the plate), the random seed, and how many wells a guide must appear in before it is testable. They apply to the gene pass as well as the guide pass: a gene is tested as a SET, its regressor the sum of its guides' fractions, permuted with the same scheme and the same seed and corrected as its own family — never by combining its guides' P values, which would assume an independence guides scored in the same wells do not have.
records.translation: 추론 방식이 비모수 검정으로 정해질 때만 읽습니다. 순열 자체를 제어합니다. 측정 대상, 재섞기 횟수, 고정할 단위(보통 플레이트), 랜덤 시드, 그리고 가이드가 검정 가능해지기 전에 나타나야 하는 웰 수입니다. 이 설정은 가이드 단계뿐 아니라 유전자 단계에도 적용됩니다. 유전자는 집합(SET)으로 검정되며, 그 회귀 변수는 가이드 비율의 합이고, 같은 방식과 같은 시드로 순열되며 별도의 계열로 보정됩니다. 가이드의 P 값을 결합하는 방식은 절대 쓰지 않습니다. 그 방식은 같은 웰에서 점수가 매겨진 가이드에는 없는 독립성을 가정하기 때문입니다.

records.key: Read the cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm tables out of the attached databases and attach them to these cells, so every measurement in the screen can be compared.
records.source: Read the cell, nucleus, pathogen and cytoplasm tables out of the attached databases and attach them to these cells, so every measurement in the screen can be compared.
records.translation: 세포, 핵, 병원체 및 세포 플라스마 테이블을 첨부된 데이터베이스에서 읽고 이러한 세포에 붙여서 화면의 모든 측정이 비교될 수 있습니다.

records.key: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s).
records.source: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s).
records.translation: 플레이트 {plates}개, 웰 {wells}개, 가이드 {guides}개, 유전자 {genes}개, 객체 행 {objects}개를 읽었습니다.

records.key: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s). The response was read from the first {objects} object row(s); the score table is larger than the {row_cap}-row sample this reads.
records.source: Read {plates} plate(s), {wells} well(s), {guides} guide(s), {genes} gene(s) and {objects} object row(s). The response was read from the first {objects} object row(s); the score table is larger than the {row_cap}-row sample this reads.
records.translation: 플레이트 {plates}개, 웰 {wells}개, 가이드 {guides}개, 유전자 {genes}개, 객체 행 {objects}개를 읽었습니다. 반응은 처음 {objects}개 객체 행에서 읽었으며, 점수 테이블은 이 기능이 읽는 {row_cap}행 표본보다 큽니다.

records.key: Record a SHA-256 of every input and output file in the run manifest, so a result can be traced to the exact data and weights that produced it. Costs minutes on a large plate. The manifest is written either way and says which it was, so a run without hashes is never mistaken for one whose hashes matched.
records.source: Record a SHA-256 of every input and output file in the run manifest, so a result can be traced to the exact data and weights that produced it. Costs minutes on a large plate. The manifest is written either way and says which it was, so a run without hashes is never mistaken for one whose hashes matched.
records.translation: 실행 매니페스트에 모든 입력 및 출력 파일의 SHA-256을 기록하므로, 결과를 그것을 만든 정확한 데이터와 가중치까지 추적할 수 있습니다. 큰 플레이트에서는 몇 분이 걸립니다. 매니페스트는 어느 경우든 기록되며 어느 쪽인지 명시하므로, 해시 없는 실행을 해시가 일치한 실행으로 착각하는 일은 없습니다.

records.key: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.source: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.translation: 각 웰을 특징별 중앙값으로 줄이고 같은 규칙을 웰 사이에 적용합니다. 웰 전체가 불량이어도 개별 객체는 거의 플래그되지 않으므로, 이것은 위 검정의 요약이 아니라 별개의 검정입니다.

records.key: Reference used to compute the implied score. The screen median is estimated from all measured objects. The fitted intercept is the model reference and, for a well-level fit, represents a well with zero guide fraction. The selected reference is reported in the caption.
records.source: Reference used to compute the implied score. The screen median is estimated from all measured objects. The fitted intercept is the model reference and, for a well-level fit, represents a well with zero guide fraction. The selected reference is reported in the caption.
records.translation: 암시된 점수를 계산하는 데 사용하는 기준입니다. 스크리닝 중앙값은 측정된 모든 객체에서 추정됩니다. 적합된 절편은 모델 기준이며, 웰 수준 적합에서는 가이드 비율이 0인 웰을 나타냅니다. 선택한 기준은 캡션에 보고됩니다.

records.key: Refresh crops
records.source: Refresh crops
records.translation: 크롭을 새롭게

records.key: Register the ROI as a Measure region filter, here and in every worker process
records.source: Register the ROI as a Measure region filter, here and in every worker process
records.translation: ROI를 여기와 모든 워커 프로세스에서 측정 영역 필터로 등록

records.key: Remove the annotations on this page only. Undoable.
records.source: Remove the annotations on this page only. Undoable.
records.translation: 이 페이지의 어노테이션만 삭제하십시오.불가능합니다.

records.key: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.source: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.translation: 요청한 워커 수입니다. 스윕은 사용 가능한 메모리에 따라 이 값을 제한합니다. 커널이 강제하는 시행별 제한이 활성화되어 있는지는 아래의 Containment를 참조하세요.

records.key: Resume, failure tolerance, dry runs, worker count and verbosity for the import. Enable strict errors when validating a new external data source.
records.source: Resume, failure tolerance, dry runs, worker count and verbosity for the import. Enable strict errors when validating a new external data source.
records.translation: 가져오기의 재개, 실패 허용치, 시험 실행, 워커 수, 출력 상세도입니다. 새 외부 데이터 원본을 검증할 때는 엄격한 오류를 켜세요.

records.key: Review single-object image crops on a grid and label them; annotations save back to the database.
records.source: Review single-object image crops on a grid and label them; annotations save back to the database.
records.translation: 네트워크에 단일 개체 이미지 크롭을 검토하고 그들을 표시; 기록은 데이터베이스로 다시 저장됩니다.

records.key: Robust M-estimation with a Huber loss, tuned by huber_t (default 1.345, which is 95% efficient under normality). Wells far from the fit are down-weighted instead of dragging it, and no R-squared is reported.
records.source: Robust M-estimation with a Huber loss, tuned by huber_t (default 1.345, which is 95% efficient under normality). Wells far from the fit are down-weighted instead of dragging it, and no R-squared is reported.
records.translation: huber_t(기본값 1.345, 정규성 아래에서 95% 효율)로 조정하는 Huber 손실의 강건한 M-추정입니다. 적합에서 멀리 떨어진 웰은 적합을 끌어당기는 대신 가중치가 낮아지며, R 제곱은 보고되지 않습니다.

records.key: Save annotated table
records.source: Save annotated table
records.translation: 어노테이션된 테이블을 저장하세요

records.key: Saving annotated table…
records.source: Saving annotated table…
records.translation: 어노테이션된 테이블을 저장하는 ...

records.key: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.source: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.translation: 두 개 이상의 어노테이션이 Cohen의 또는 Fleiss의 κ에 동의하는 방법을 평가하고 각 크롭을 다른 방식으로 표시합니다.

records.key: Search definitions of measured features by name or concept
records.source: Search definitions of measured features by name or concept
records.translation: 측정 특징의 정의를 이름이나 개념으로 검색

records.key: Search every recorded job and inspect its exact settings, hashed inputs and outputs, warnings, failure traceback, software versions, seeds and performance.
records.source: Search every recorded job and inspect its exact settings, hashed inputs and outputs, warnings, failure traceback, software versions, seeds and performance.
records.translation: 기록된 모든 작업을 검색하고 정확한 설정, 해시된 입력과 출력, 경고, 실패 traceback, 소프트웨어 버전, 시드, 성능을 확인합니다.

records.key: Search every recorded job and inspect its settings, inputs, outputs, warnings, failure traceback, versions, seeds, and performance in one place.
records.source: Search every recorded job and inspect its settings, inputs, outputs, warnings, failure traceback, versions, seeds, and performance in one place.
records.translation: 기록된 모든 작업을 검색하고 설정, 입력, 출력, 경고, 실패 traceback, 버전, 시드, 성능을 한곳에서 확인합니다.

records.key: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.source: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.translation: 검색 실패: 워커가 결과를 반환하지 않았습니다.

records.key: Segment cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles with Cellpose and build the merged image+mask arrays.
records.source: Segment cells, nuclei, pathogens and organelles with Cellpose and build the merged image+mask arrays.
records.translation: Cellpose로 세포, 핵, 병원체, 소기관을 분할하고 병합된 이미지+마스크 배열을 만듭니다.

records.key: Segment each frame of a time series and link objects across frames into tracks, then export per-channel movies.
records.source: Segment each frame of a time series and link objects across frames into tracks, then export per-channel movies.
records.translation: 시간 시리즈의 각 프레임을 분할하고 프레임을 통해 개체를 트랙으로 연결하고, 그 다음 채널별 영화를 수출합니다.

records.key: Segment the same three fields with two Cellpose models and see what changed: masks side by side, object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.source: Segment the same three fields with two Cellpose models and see what changed: masks side by side, object counts, the background-excluded ARI, and whether the extra objects are new cells or fragments of old ones.
records.translation: 두 개의 Cellpose 모델과 같은 세 필드를 분할하고 변경 된 것을 확인하십시오 : 측면에서 측면으로 마스크, 개체 계산, 배경 제외 ARI, 그리고 추가 개체가 새로운 세포 또는 오래된 부분인지 여부.

records.key: Segmentation (cached — changing these re-segments)
records.source: Segmentation (cached — changing these re-segments)
records.translation: 분할 (카세드 - 이러한 재 분할을 변경)

records.key: Segmentation QC — could not score these masks
records.source: Segmentation QC — could not score these masks
records.translation: 분할 QC - 이 마스크를 점수 할 수 없었다

records.key: Segmentation QC — scoring the masks…
records.source: Segmentation QC — scoring the masks…
records.translation: 분할 QC — 마스크를 점수 ...

records.key: Select a column containing reference annotations. If omitted, reference labels are derived by thresholding the score and the report identifies this limitation.
records.source: Select a column containing reference annotations. If omitted, reference labels are derived by thresholding the score and the report identifies this limitation.
records.translation: 참조 어노테이션을 포함하는 열을 선택합니다. 놓친 경우, 참조 라벨은 점수를 제한하여 추출되며 보고서는이 제한을 식별합니다.

records.key: Select the column that defines object classes, then score and rank continuous features by class separation. The default AUC metric is rank-based and independent of measurement units. The results describe limitations of the selected statistic, flag features whose classes differ primarily in spread, and use a permutation test to estimate the best separation expected by chance across the feature set.
records.source: Select the column that defines object classes, then score and rank continuous features by class separation. The default AUC metric is rank-based and independent of measurement units. The results describe limitations of the selected statistic, flag features whose classes differ primarily in spread, and use a permutation test to estimate the best separation expected by chance across the feature set.
records.translation: 객체 클래스를 정의하는 열을 선택한 다음, 연속형 특징을 클래스 분리도에 따라 점수화하고 순위를 매깁니다. 기본 AUC 지표는 순위 기반이며 측정 단위와 무관합니다. 결과는 선택한 통계량의 한계를 설명하고, 클래스 간 차이가 주로 퍼짐에 있는 특징을 표시하며, 순열 검정으로 특징 세트 전체에서 우연히 기대되는 최고 분리도를 추정합니다.

records.key: Select the estimation level and inference method independently. 'Level' requests one effect per guide, one per gene, or separate results for both. 'Parametric' inference fits all terms simultaneously and therefore requires more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' inference tests terms by plate-blocked permutation; 'auto' selects the method supported by the design. 'Regression type' selects the fitted model family. The mixed model nests guides within genes and reports both levels.
records.source: Select the estimation level and inference method independently. 'Level' requests one effect per guide, one per gene, or separate results for both. 'Parametric' inference fits all terms simultaneously and therefore requires more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' inference tests terms by plate-blocked permutation; 'auto' selects the method supported by the design. 'Regression type' selects the fitted model family. The mixed model nests guides within genes and reports both levels.
records.translation: 추정 수준과 추론 방법을 따로 선택합니다. 'Level'은 가이드당 효과 하나, 유전자당 효과 하나, 또는 둘 다에 대한 별도 결과를 요청합니다. 'Parametric' 추론은 모든 항을 동시에 적합하므로 항보다 많은 웰이 필요합니다. 'nonparametric' 추론은 플레이트로 블록화한 순열로 항을 검정합니다. 'auto'는 설계가 지원하는 방법을 선택합니다. 'Regression type'은 적합할 모형 계열을 선택합니다. 혼합 모형은 가이드를 유전자 안에 중첩하고 두 수준을 모두 보고합니다.

records.key: Select the plate identifier, acquisition order, and control population. The application uses an individuals/moving-range chart for one control well per plate, an X-bar/S chart for multiple wells, or a robust alternative when requested. Limits are estimated from a defined baseline using short-term variation and then applied to subsequent plates. Nelson-rule violations are labelled, together with the expected false-alarm count for the selected rule set and campaign length.
records.source: Select the plate identifier, acquisition order, and control population. The application uses an individuals/moving-range chart for one control well per plate, an X-bar/S chart for multiple wells, or a robust alternative when requested. Limits are estimated from a defined baseline using short-term variation and then applied to subsequent plates. Nelson-rule violations are labelled, together with the expected false-alarm count for the selected rule set and campaign length.
records.translation: 플레이트 식별자, 획득 순서, 대조군 집단을 선택합니다. 플레이트당 대조군 웰이 하나이면 개별값/이동 범위 관리도를, 웰이 여러 개이면 X-bar/S 관리도를, 요청하면 강건한 대안을 사용합니다. 관리 한계는 단기 변동을 사용해 정의된 기준 구간에서 추정한 뒤 이후 플레이트에 적용합니다. Nelson 규칙 위반에는 레이블이 붙으며, 선택한 규칙 세트와 캠페인 길이에 대한 예상 오경보 수가 함께 표시됩니다.

records.key: Set the fraction of wells reserved before candidate selection. Reserved wells are excluded from strategy selection and used for evaluation.
records.source: Set the fraction of wells reserved before candidate selection. Reserved wells are excluded from strategy selection and used for evaluation.
records.translation: 후보 선택 전에 남겨 둘 웰의 비율을 설정합니다. 남겨 둔 웰은 전략 선택에서 제외되고 평가에 사용됩니다.

records.key: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.source: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.translation: 어노테이션 예산을 나눌 특징 공간 클러스터 수를 설정합니다. 0이면 대기열의 세포마다 클러스터 하나를 사용합니다.

records.key: Set the number of nearest neighbours evaluated for each seed. Only neighbours within the distance threshold inherit a label.
records.source: Set the number of nearest neighbours evaluated for each seed. Only neighbours within the distance threshold inherit a label.
records.translation: 각 시드에 대해 평가할 최근접 이웃 수를 설정합니다. 거리 임계값 안에 있는 이웃만 레이블을 물려받습니다.

records.key: Set the random seed used for hold-out selection, sampling, and model fitting. Reusing the seed reproduces the same selection.
records.source: Set the random seed used for hold-out selection, sampling, and model fitting. Reusing the seed reproduces the same selection.
records.translation: 보류 세트 선택, 샘플링, 모델 적합에 사용할 랜덤 시드를 설정합니다. 같은 시드를 다시 쓰면 같은 선택이 재현됩니다.

records.key: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.source: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.translation: 워커 병렬 처리와 진단 출력 상세도를 설정합니다. 메모리가 부족하면 워커 수를 줄이고, 실패한 실행을 추적할 때는 로그를 늘리세요.

records.key: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.source: Show the requested number of crops whose measurements are most like the selected crop, the one with the ring, most similar first, so a rare class found once can be labelled many times. The first search on a source reads its measurements and takes a few seconds; later ones are instant. Back to all crops by opening the source again. Default not run.
records.translation: 선택한 크롭과 가장 비슷한 측정이 있는 크롭의 요청된 수를 보여주고, 반지를 가진 크롭은 가장 먼저 비슷하므로 한 번 발견된 희귀한 클래스는 여러 번 표시될 수 있습니다. 원본에 대한 첫 번째 검색은 측정을 읽고 몇 초가 걸립니다. 나중에 측정은 즉각적입니다. 다시 원본을 열어 모든 크롭으로 돌아가십시오. 기본적으로 실행하지 마십시오.

records.key: Show the selected objects as crops, parents first.
records.source: Show the selected objects as crops, parents first.
records.translation: 선택한 물건을 크롭으로 표시, 부모는 먼저.

records.key: Summarize annotation provenance by class, well, plate and active-learning round. This identifies label sets concentrated within a small number of wells or plates.
records.source: Summarize annotation provenance by class, well, plate and active-learning round. This identifies label sets concentrated within a small number of wells or plates.
records.translation: 어노테이션 출처를 클래스, 웰, 플레이트, 능동 학습 라운드별로 요약합니다. 이를 통해 소수의 웰이나 플레이트에 집중된 레이블 세트를 찾아냅니다.

records.key: Ten ways of choosing WHICH of these cells get annotated, each saying what it is for and what it costs — the top-scoring cells against a matched random draw, uncertainty and diversity sampling, control wells as anchors, positive-unlabelled learning, self-training, two-view disagreement, score strata, neighbour propagation, and the plain random draw every one of them is measured against. Wells are never split across train and test, and the fit is reported with the score's own inputs removed as well as kept.
records.source: Ten ways of choosing WHICH of these cells get annotated, each saying what it is for and what it costs — the top-scoring cells against a matched random draw, uncertainty and diversity sampling, control wells as anchors, positive-unlabelled learning, self-training, two-view disagreement, score strata, neighbour propagation, and the plain random draw every one of them is measured against. Wells are never split across train and test, and the fit is reported with the score's own inputs removed as well as kept.
records.translation: 이 세포 중 어떤 세포에 어노테이션을 달지 고르는 열 가지 방법이며, 각각 용도와 비용을 설명합니다. 일치시킨 무작위 추출과 비교한 최고 점수 세포, 불확실성 및 다양성 샘플링, 기준점으로서의 대조군 웰, positive-unlabelled 학습, 자기 학습, 두 관점 불일치, 점수 층, 이웃 전파, 그리고 이 모든 방법의 비교 기준인 단순 무작위 추출입니다. 웰은 학습과 테스트에 걸쳐 나뉘지 않으며, 적합 결과는 점수 자체의 입력을 제거한 경우와 유지한 경우 모두 보고됩니다.

records.key: Test on 3 fields
records.source: Test on 3 fields
records.translation: 시야 3개로 테스트

records.key: The area window a segmented object has to fall inside to count as a parasite. Debris below it and clumps above it are excluded.
records.source: The area window a segmented object has to fall inside to count as a parasite. Debris below it and clumps above it are excluded.
records.translation: 영역 창에서 분할된 개체가 항생제로 계산하기 위해 내부에 떨어져 있어야 합니다.그것 아래에 굴러가고 위의 클럼프가 배제됩니다.

records.key: The colour map the assay's figures are drawn with, how many QC panels are produced, and whether wells with cells but no scored parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the invasion rate.
records.source: The colour map the assay's figures are drawn with, how many QC panels are produced, and whether wells with cells but no scored parasites are seeded as zeros. Leaving those wells out silently inflates the invasion rate.
records.translation: 분석 그림에 쓰는 색상 맵, 생성할 QC 패널 수, 그리고 세포는 있지만 점수가 매겨진 기생충이 없는 웰을 0으로 채울지 여부입니다. 그런 웰을 빼면 침입률이 조용히 부풀려집니다.

records.key: The column saying what each well is. Leave empty when the table is already only the control.
records.source: The column saying what each well is. Leave empty when the table is already only the control.
records.translation: 각 웰이 무엇인지 나타내는 열입니다. 테이블에 이미 대조군만 있으면 비워 두세요.

records.key: The expected plaque diameter, and whether previously written masks are reused instead of segmenting again. Plaques are far larger than cells, so the default cell-sized expectation is almost never right here.
records.source: The expected plaque diameter, and whether previously written masks are reused instead of segmenting again. Plaques are far larger than cells, so the default cell-sized expectation is almost never right here.

records.key:
Two questions, asked in order. WHAT IS ESTIMATED is 'Level': 'gRNA' gives one estimate per guide, 'gene' one estimate per gene with its guides pooled, 'both' gives each separately, corrected as its own family. HOW THE P VALUE IS REACHED is 'Inference': 'parametric' fits every term at once and needs more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' tests each term on its own by permutation and has no such limit; 'auto' counts them and picks. The two are independent — every level is available under either.
A THIRD ANALYSIS exists on the fitted side only: 'Regression type' = 'mixed' estimates gene effects while modelling the guide-to-guide spread inside each gene, which is why it answers both levels at once and greys 'Level'. There is no permutation equivalent — a variance component is something a model estimates — so under nonparametric inference the family is not read at all and says so.
Below them: the multiple-testing correction applied across the tested family, the level it targets, and the control-based effect-size threshold. With hundreds of guides an uncorrected P value is not evidence. Together, these settings define what counts as a hit.
records.source:
Two questions, asked in order. WHAT IS ESTIMATED is 'Level': 'gRNA' gives one estimate per guide, 'gene' one estimate per gene with its guides pooled, 'both' gives each separately, corrected as its own family. HOW THE P VALUE IS REACHED is 'Inference': 'parametric' fits every term at once and needs more wells than terms; 'nonparametric' tests each term on its own by permutation and has no such limit; 'auto' counts them and picks. The two are independent — every level is available under either.
A THIRD ANALYSIS exists on the fitted side only: 'Regression type' = 'mixed' estimates gene effects while modelling the guide-to-guide spread inside each gene, which is why it answers both levels at once and greys 'Level'. There is no permutation equivalent — a variance component is something a model estimates — so under nonparametric inference the family is not read at all and says so.
Below them: the multiple-testing correction applied across the tested family, the level it targets, and the control-based effect-size threshold. With hundreds of guides an uncorrected P value is not evidence. Together, these settings define what counts as a hit.
records.translation:
두 질문을 순서대로 묻습니다. 무엇을 추정하는가는 'Level'입니다. 'gRNA'는 가이드당 추정치 하나, 'gene'은 가이드를 합친 유전자당 추정치 하나, 'both'는 각각을 따로 제공하며 각자의 계열로 보정합니다. P 값을 어떻게 얻는가는 'Inference'입니다. 'parametric'은 모든 항을 한 번에 적합하며 항보다 많은 웰이 필요합니다. 'nonparametric'은 각 항을 순열로 따로 검정하며 그런 제한이 없습니다. 'auto'는 개수를 세어 선택합니다. 두 질문은 독립적이며, 어느 쪽에서든 모든 수준을 쓸 수 있습니다.
세 번째 분석은 적합 쪽에만 있습니다. 'Regression type' = 'mixed'는 각 유전자 안의 가이드 간 퍼짐을 모델링하면서 유전자 효과를 추정하므로, 두 수준에 한 번에 답하며 'Level'을 회색으로 표시합니다. 분산 성분은 모형이 추정하는 것이므로 순열에 해당하는 방법은 없으며, 비모수 추론에서는 이 계열을 전혀 읽지 않고 그렇다고 알려 줍니다.
그 아래에는 검정 계열 전체에 적용하는 다중 검정 보정, 그 목표 수준, 대조군 기반 효과 크기 임계값이 있습니다. 가이드가 수백 개이면 보정하지 않은 P 값은 증거가 아닙니다. 이 설정들이 함께 무엇을 히트로 볼지를 정의합니다.

records.key: Use the RAPIDS cuML backend for both the main dimensionality-reduction run and hyperparameter search. CPU and GPU reducers may produce different embeddings, so compare search results only within the same backend.
records.source: Use the RAPIDS cuML backend for both the main dimensionality-reduction run and hyperparameter search. CPU and GPU reducers may produce different embeddings, so compare search results only within the same backend.
records.translation: 주요 차원 감소 실행 및 하이퍼파라미터 검색을 위해 RAPIDS cuML 배경을 사용하십시오. CPU 및 GPU 감소기는 다른 임베딩을 생성할 수 있으므로 검색 결과를 동일한 배경 내에서만 비교합니다.

records.key: Well-level bootstrap/permutation evidence, blinded gallery sampling, versioned database storage and exported artifacts.
records.source: Well-level bootstrap/permutation evidence, blinded gallery sampling, versioned database storage and exported artifacts.
records.translation: 웰 수준 부트스트랩/순열 증거, 블라인드 갤러리 샘플링, 버전 관리 데이터베이스 저장, 내보낸 결과물.

records.key: Wells whose cells are known negatives.
records.source: Wells whose cells are known negatives.
records.translation: 세포가 음성으로 알려진 웰입니다.

records.key: What defines a class. Pick the training basis first — metadata (the wells named as positive and negative control), annotation (a column the Annotate module wrote), or measurement (thresholds on measured features). The controls the other two bases use are greyed out, not hidden: they keep their values. Get this wrong and every number downstream is meaningless, so check it first.
records.source: What defines a class. Pick the training basis first — metadata (the wells named as positive and negative control), annotation (a column the Annotate module wrote), or measurement (thresholds on measured features). The controls the other two bases use are greyed out, not hidden: they keep their values. Get this wrong and every number downstream is meaningless, so check it first.
records.translation: 클래스를 정의하는 기준입니다. 먼저 학습 기준을 고르세요. 메타데이터(양성 및 음성 대조군으로 지정한 웰), 어노테이션(Annotate 모듈이 기록한 열), 또는 측정값(측정 특징에 대한 임계값)입니다. 다른 두 기준이 쓰는 컨트롤은 숨겨지지 않고 회색으로 표시되며 값을 유지합니다. 이것이 틀리면 이후의 모든 수치가 무의미해지므로 먼저 확인하세요.

records.key: What happens to an object with no children when tables are merged. A cell with no pathogens genuinely has a pathogen COUNT of zero, and genuinely has no pathogen mean intensity at all — so 'keep' leaves that blank rather than inventing a zero.
records.source: What happens to an object with no children when tables are merged. A cell with no pathogens genuinely has a pathogen COUNT of zero, and genuinely has no pathogen mean intensity at all — so 'keep' leaves that blank rather than inventing a zero.
records.translation: 테이블을 병합할 때 자식이 없는 객체를 처리하는 방식입니다. 병원체가 없는 세포는 실제로 병원체 개수(COUNT)가 0이며, 병원체 평균 강도는 아예 없습니다. 그래서 'keep'은 0을 지어내지 않고 빈칸으로 둡니다.

records.key: What is being modelled: which score column (or columns — name several and each is fitted and corrected as its own family), whether one row is a well or a single cell, and how the values are collapsed and transformed before the model sees them.
records.source: What is being modelled: which score column (or columns — name several and each is fitted and corrected as its own family), whether one row is a well or a single cell, and how the values are collapsed and transformed before the model sees them.
records.translation: 무엇을 모델링하는지입니다. 어떤 점수 열(또는 여러 열 — 여러 개를 지정하면 각각 별도의 계열로 적합하고 보정함)을 쓰는지, 한 행이 웰인지 단일 세포인지, 모델이 보기 전에 값을 어떻게 요약하고 변환하는지를 정합니다.

records.key: What is done to each object's own channel before anything is segmented — the background floor below which pixels are zeroed, the signal-to-noise ratio that sets where the contrast stretch tops out, and, for organelles, rolling-ball flattening and CLAHE. The objects do not all offer the same steps, and each sub-heading shows exactly the ones its object has.
records.source: What is done to each object's own channel before anything is segmented — the background floor below which pixels are zeroed, the signal-to-noise ratio that sets where the contrast stretch tops out, and, for organelles, rolling-ball flattening and CLAHE. The objects do not all offer the same steps, and each sub-heading shows exactly the ones its object has.
records.translation: 모든 것이 분할되기 전에 각 개체의 자신의 채널에 무엇이 이루어지는지 - 픽셀이 0 아래의 배경 바닥, 반대 스트레치가 어디를 설정하는 신호-소음 비율, 그리고, organelles, 롤링-볼 플레팅 및 CLAHE.

records.key: What the training run begins from — a pretrained model fine-tuned on your data, or randomly initialised weights — and the name the result is saved under. Fine-tuning needs far fewer labelled images than starting from scratch.
records.source: What the training run begins from — a pretrained model fine-tuned on your data, or randomly initialised weights — and the name the result is saved under. Fine-tuning needs far fewer labelled images than starting from scratch.
records.translation: 학습 실행의 시작점(데이터로 미세 조정할 사전 학습 모델 또는 무작위로 초기화한 가중치)과 결과를 저장할 이름입니다. 미세 조정은 처음부터 학습하는 것보다 훨씬 적은 레이블 이미지가 필요합니다.

records.key: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.source: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.translation: 훈련 이미지가 어디에서 왔는지 그리고 어떻게 절단되는지 - 크롭의 출처, 이미 디스크에있는 크롭에 대한 경로 및 형식 필터, 그리고 수요에 따라 만들어진 크롭을위한 채널 및 개체를 절단하는 방법.

records.key: Whether maps are saved, whether the input order is shuffled, and the batch size and worker count used to generate them.
records.source: Whether maps are saved, whether the input order is shuffled, and the batch size and worker count used to generate them.
records.translation: 맵을 저장할지, 입력 순서를 섞을지, 그리고 맵 생성에 사용할 배치 크기와 워커 수입니다.

records.key: Whether one y unit is drawn the same length as one x unit ('equal', which is what keeps a plate's wells square), or the panel is filled instead ('auto'). This locks the axis scales, which is a statement about the data; the proportions of the figure are 'Page shape'.
records.source: Whether one y unit is drawn the same length as one x unit ('equal', which is what keeps a plate's wells square), or the panel is filled instead ('auto'). This locks the axis scales, which is a statement about the data; the proportions of the figure are 'Page shape'.
records.translation: y 한 단위를 x 한 단위와 같은 길이로 그릴지('equal', 플레이트의 웰을 정사각형으로 유지함), 아니면 대신 패널을 채울지('auto')입니다. 이는 데이터에 대한 진술인 축 척도를 고정합니다. 그림의 비율은 'Page shape'에서 정합니다.

records.key: Whether per-plate offsets are removed before analysis, which column identifies the batch, and which wells anchor the correction. Use it when plates were run on different days or instruments and plate identity shows up as a larger effect than the biology.
records.source: Whether per-plate offsets are removed before analysis, which column identifies the batch, and which wells anchor the correction. Use it when plates were run on different days or instruments and plate identity shows up as a larger effect than the biology.
records.translation: 분석 전에 플레이트별 오프셋을 제거할지, 어떤 열이 배치를 식별하는지, 어떤 웰을 보정의 기준으로 삼을지입니다. 플레이트를 서로 다른 날이나 장비에서 실행해 플레이트 정체가 생물학적 효과보다 큰 효과로 나타날 때 사용하세요.

records.key: Which feature the heatmap shows, how wells are grouped, and the colour map and value range used to draw it. Presentation of the classifier's output; it does not change the fit.
records.source: Which feature the heatmap shows, how wells are grouped, and the colour map and value range used to draw it. Presentation of the classifier's output; it does not change the fit.
records.translation: 히트맵이 보여 줄 특징, 웰을 묶는 방식, 그리고 그릴 때 쓰는 색상 맵과 값 범위입니다. 분류기 출력의 표시 방식일 뿐 적합은 바꾸지 않습니다.

records.key: Which mask plane a crop is cut by. 'cytoplasm' has no plane on disk and is derived as cell minus nucleus/pathogen, exactly as measure_crop derives it.
records.source: Which mask plane a crop is cut by. 'cytoplasm' has no plane on disk and is derived as cell minus nucleus/pathogen, exactly as measure_crop derives it.
records.translation: 크롭을 잘라낼 마스크 평면입니다. 'cytoplasm'은 디스크에 평면이 없으며, measure_crop과 똑같이 세포에서 핵/병원체를 뺀 영역으로 도출됩니다.

records.key: Which measurement columns are allowed into the model, and the variance, correlation, object-count and compartment filters applied before fitting. Prune here when the feature table is wide, redundant, or contains a column that leaks the answer.
records.source: Which measurement columns are allowed into the model, and the variance, correlation, object-count and compartment filters applied before fitting. Prune here when the feature table is wide, redundant, or contains a column that leaks the answer.
records.translation: 모델에 허용할 측정 열과, 적합 전에 적용할 분산, 상관, 객체 수, 구획 필터입니다. 특징 테이블이 넓거나 중복되거나 답을 누출하는 열이 있을 때 여기서 가지치기하세요.

records.key: Which of the segmented objects the source view is showing.
records.source: Which of the segmented objects the source view is showing.
records.translation: 어떤 분할된 개체에서 출처 전망이 나타납니다.

records.key: Which rows reach the model, and what they are measured against. The plate identifier, the positive and negative control wells, any row filter — and every cutoff that drops data: minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. The controls set the scale the effect sizes are reported on; each cutoff silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing one.
records.source: Which rows reach the model, and what they are measured against. The plate identifier, the positive and negative control wells, any row filter — and every cutoff that drops data: minimum cells per well, minimum observations per guide, the read-fraction cutoff and outlier removal. The controls set the scale the effect sizes are reported on; each cutoff silently shrinks the dataset, so check the diagnostics after changing one.
records.translation: 어떤 행이 모델에 도달하고 무엇을 기준으로 측정하는지입니다. 플레이트 식별자, 양성 및 음성 대조군 웰, 행 필터, 그리고 데이터를 제외하는 모든 컷오프(웰당 최소 세포 수, 가이드당 최소 관측 수, 리드 비율 컷오프, 이상치 제거)를 다룹니다. 대조군은 효과 크기를 보고하는 척도를 정하고, 각 컷오프는 데이터 세트를 조용히 줄이므로 하나라도 바꾼 뒤에는 진단을 확인하세요.

records.key: Which segmented objects survive into the measurement table: the minimum size per compartment, whether uninfected cells are kept, and whether a pathogen straddling two cells merges them. Change them when debris is being measured, or when real cells vanish.
records.source: Which segmented objects survive into the measurement table: the minimum size per compartment, whether uninfected cells are kept, and whether a pathogen straddling two cells merges them. Change them when debris is being measured, or when real cells vanish.
records.translation: 측정 테이블에 남을 분할 객체입니다. 구획별 최소 크기, 감염되지 않은 세포를 유지할지, 두 세포에 걸친 병원체가 두 세포를 병합할지를 정합니다. 잔해가 측정되거나 실제 세포가 사라질 때 바꾸세요.

records.key: Which source channel is drawn in each colour slot. This is a VIEW setting and changes nothing on disk and nothing measured — it does not say how the file was written, which is the row above. Use it when a project authored before the crop-format fix should be seen in the colours it was authored for: B G R restores that picture without marking the folder as a format it is not.
records.source: Which source channel is drawn in each colour slot. This is a VIEW setting and changes nothing on disk and nothing measured — it does not say how the file was written, which is the row above. Use it when a project authored before the crop-format fix should be seen in the colours it was authored for: B G R restores that picture without marking the folder as a format it is not.
records.translation: 어떤 출처 채널은 각 색상 슬롯에 끌려 있습니다.이것은 VIEW 설정이며 디스크에 아무것도 변경하지 않고 측정되지 않습니다 - 그것은 파일이 어떻게 작성되었는지 말하지 않습니다, 이는 위의 순서입니다. 크롭 형식 수정 전에 작성된 프로젝트가 그것을 위해 작성된 색상에서 볼 수있을 때 사용하십시오 : B G R는 그것이 아닌 형식으로 폴더를 표시하지 않고 그 그림을 복원합니다.

records.key: Which stages run, whether this is a small test pass, and how the run behaves under load and failure — workers, batch size, tolerated failure rate and verbosity. Track a few fields in test mode before committing to a whole plate.
records.source: Which stages run, whether this is a small test pass, and how the run behaves under load and failure — workers, batch size, tolerated failure rate and verbosity. Track a few fields in test mode before committing to a whole plate.
records.translation: 실행할 단계, 소규모 테스트 실행인지 여부, 그리고 부하와 실패 상황에서 실행이 동작하는 방식(워커, 배치 크기, 허용 실패율, 출력 상세도)입니다. 플레이트 전체를 실행하기 전에 테스트 모드에서 시야 몇 개를 추적해 보세요.

records.key: Which weights do the segmenting — a packaged model, or a checkpoint of your own — and the object size they should expect. Nothing is trained here; this is the picker, and the expected size matters more than the choice of weights.
records.source: Which weights do the segmenting — a packaged model, or a checkpoint of your own — and the object size they should expect. Nothing is trained here; this is the picker, and the expected size matters more than the choice of weights.
records.translation: 분할에 쓸 가중치(패키지 모델 또는 자체 체크포인트)와 예상할 객체 크기입니다. 여기서는 아무것도 학습하지 않으며, 이것은 선택기입니다. 예상 크기가 가중치 선택보다 더 중요합니다.

records.key: Which wells anchor the threshold, and how many objects a well or a plate must contribute before its number is believed. Raise the minimums when sparse wells produce implausibly extreme rates.
records.source: Which wells anchor the threshold, and how many objects a well or a plate must contribute before its number is believed. Raise the minimums when sparse wells produce implausibly extreme rates.
records.translation: 임계값의 기준이 될 웰과, 웰이나 플레이트의 값을 신뢰하기 전에 필요한 객체 수입니다. 희소한 웰에서 타당하지 않게 극단적인 비율이 나오면 최솟값을 높이세요.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the conditions are grouped and reported at.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the conditions are grouped and reported at.
records.translation: 어떤 웰에 어떤 세포주, 균주, 처리가 들어 있는지, 그리고 조건을 묶어 보고할 열과 수준입니다.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the invasion rates are grouped and reported at.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and the column and level the invasion rates are grouped and reported at.
records.translation: 어떤 웰에 어떤 세포주, 균주, 처리가 들어 있는지, 그리고 침입률을 묶어 보고할 열과 수준입니다.

records.key: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and which channel the recruitment is measured on. Filled in once per plate design.
records.source: Which wells hold which cell line, strain and treatment, and which channel the recruitment is measured on. Filled in once per plate design.
records.translation: 어떤 웰에 어떤 세포주, 균주, 처리가 들어 있는지, 그리고 동원을 측정할 채널입니다. 플레이트 설계마다 한 번 채웁니다.

records.key: Write a suggestion onto every crop with no answer yet, most confident first. Nothing you have already annotated is touched.
records.source: Write a suggestion onto every crop with no answer yet, most confident first. Nothing you have already annotated is touched.
records.translation: 모든 크롭에 대한 제안을 쓰고 아직 답변이 없습니다, 가장 자신감 먼저.

records.key: Write the annotation selection into…
records.source: Write the annotation selection into…
records.translation: 어노테이션에 대한 선택을 작성하십시오 ...

records.key: Write the whole table with the flag columns added, the flagged rows on their own, and the per-well summary
records.source: Write the whole table with the flag columns added, the flagged rows on their own, and the per-well summary
records.translation: 플래그 열을 추가한 전체 테이블, 플래그된 행만 모은 테이블, 웰별 요약을 기록합니다

records.key: grid evaluates every combination; random samples n trials from the space with the seed below, which is reproducible.
records.source: grid evaluates every combination; random samples n trials from the space with the seed below, which is reproducible.
records.translation: grid는 모든 조합을 평가하고, random은 아래 시드로 공간에서 n개의 시행을 추출하므로 재현할 수 있습니다.

records.key: hinge — parametric: a linear boundary between a positive and a negative class: the response is thresholded, so the question is which class a well is in, not by how much
records.source: hinge — parametric: a linear boundary between a positive and a negative class: the response is thresholded, so the question is which class a well is in, not by how much
records.translation: hinge — 모수적: 양성 클래스와 음성 클래스 사이의 선형 경계입니다. 반응에 임계값을 적용하므로, 질문은 웰이 얼마나 다른지가 아니라 어느 클래스에 속하는지입니다

records.key: huber — robust/semiparametric: squared loss near the centre and linear in the tails, so a handful of bright wells cannot set a coefficient
records.source: huber — robust/semiparametric: squared loss near the centre and linear in the tails, so a handful of bright wells cannot set a coefficient
records.translation: huber — 강건/반모수적: 중앙 근처에서는 제곱 손실, 꼬리에서는 선형 손실이므로 밝은 웰 몇 개가 계수를 좌우할 수 없습니다

records.key: logit — parametric: a fraction as a binomial proportion, log-odds linear in the guides, weighted by the cells behind the well
records.source: logit — parametric: a fraction as a binomial proportion, log-odds linear in the guides, weighted by the cells behind the well
records.translation: logit — 모수적: 비율을 이항 비율로 보고, 로그 오즈가 가이드에 대해 선형이며, 웰의 세포 수로 가중합니다

records.key: no crops loaded
records.source: no crops loaded
records.translation: 크롭은 충전되지 않음

records.key: ols — parametric: least squares: normal errors of constant variance, every well equal
records.source: ols — parametric: least squares: normal errors of constant variance, every well equal
records.translation: ols — 모수적: 최소제곱. 분산이 일정한 정규 오차이며 모든 웰이 같은 비중을 갖습니다

records.key: rlm — robust/semiparametric: a linear model fitted by an M-estimator, so extreme wells are downweighted rather than assumed absent
records.source: rlm — robust/semiparametric: a linear model fitted by an M-estimator, so extreme wells are downweighted rather than assumed absent
records.translation: rlm — 강건/반모수적: M-추정량으로 적합한 선형 모형이므로, 극단적인 웰은 없는 것으로 가정되지 않고 가중치가 낮아집니다

records.key: rra — rank-based: only the ORDER of the wells, so no distribution at all; its p value is a permutation p value over guide ranks
records.source: rra — rank-based: only the ORDER of the wells, so no distribution at all; its p value is a permutation p value over guide ranks
records.translation: rra — 순위 기반: 웰의 순서만 사용하므로 분포 가정이 전혀 없습니다. p 값은 가이드 순위에 대한 순열 p 값입니다

records.source: spaCR defaults active — one row per {base}. Children are aggregated before joining; unmatched measurements stay missing. Nucleus uses an inner join; pathogen/organelle retain uninfected cells by default.
records.translation: spaCR 결함은 활성 - {base}에 한 줄입니다.아이들은 합류하기 전에 집합됩니다.결합되지 않은 측정은 사라집니다.핵은 내부 결함을 사용합니다.병원체/organelle은 결함으로써 감염되지 않은 세포를 유지합니다.

records.source: ■ The design in the count files: {genes} genes and {guides} guides over {wells} wells, from {rows} rows in {files} file(s). That is BEFORE the merge with the scores and before the filters — the run's own counts follow.
records.translation: ■ 카운트 파일의 설계: 유전자 {genes}개와 가이드 {guides}개, 웰 {wells}개이며, {rows}행, 파일 {files}개에서 읽었습니다. 이는 점수와 병합하고 필터를 적용하기 전의 값이며, 실행 자체의 개수는 뒤에 나옵니다.

records.key: curate
records.source: Correct segmentation masks and tracking assignments manually while recording each edit in the curation log.
records.translation: 올바른 분할 마스크와 수동으로 추적 작업을 기록하는 동안 각 편집을 치유 기록에.

records.key: explain_cv
records.source: Reproduce CV decisions from measured features, then inspect gain, held-out permutation importance and SHAP
records.translation: 측정 특징으로 CV 판정을 재현한 다음 gain, 보류 데이터 순열 중요도, SHAP를 검사합니다

records.key: image_scatter
records.source: Hover a point to see the cell; click it to open the crop
records.translation: 셀을 볼 수있는 포인트를 옮기십시오; 크롭을 열기 위해 그것을 클릭하십시오.

records.key: investigate_hit
records.source: Link a regression hit to cross-fitted candidate cells and well-level quantitative evidence
records.translation: 회귀 히트를 교차 적합된 후보 세포 및 웰 수준 정량 증거와 연결합니다

records.key: lineage
records.source: Inspect cell-containment relationships for nuclei, pathogens, and organelles
records.translation: 핵, 병원체, 소기관의 세포 포함 관계를 검사합니다

records.key: napari_bridge
records.source: Correct a segmentation mask in napari and import the revised labels into spaCR.
records.translation: 분할 마스크를 정리하는 방법 napari 개정된 라벨을 입력하여 spaCR.

records.key: outliers
records.source: Detect robust univariate and multivariate outliers at object and well levels
records.translation: 객체 및 웰 수준에서 강건한 단변량 및 다변량 이상치를 검출합니다

records.key: power
records.source: Estimate the cells and wells required to detect a specified effect size
records.translation: 지정한 효과 크기를 검출하는 데 필요한 세포와 웰 수를 추정합니다

records.key: qc_dashboard
records.source: Review stored checks for segmentation, units, leakage, plate effects, and annotation agreement
records.translation: 검토 분할, 단위, 유출, 플레이트 효과 및 기록 계약에 대한 저장 체크

records.key: barcode_qc
records.source: Assess mapping depth, coverage, collisions and positional effects, and estimate the abundance threshold for the intended gRNAs per well.
records.translation: 매핑 깊이, 커버리지, 충돌, 위치 효과를 평가하고, 웰당 의도한 gRNAs 수에 대한 존재량 임계값을 추정합니다.
